name: holler
description: Ask your team in Slack. Holler reminds the quiet ones and shows the results.

scripts.check: pnpm check:conflicts && oxfmt --check . && oxlint . --report-unused-disable-directives-severity error && pnpm check:design && pnpm check:design-coverage && pnpm check:styling && pnpm check:comments && pnpm check:workflows && pnpm guards:check
scripts.check:conflicts: ! git grep -nE '^(<<<<<<<|>>>>>>>) ' || (echo 'A merge conflict is committed above: resolve it.' && exit 1)
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm check:migrations && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:boundaries
scripts.deploy:health: node scripts/check-deployment.mjs https://holler.k-porshnieva.workers.dev holler && node scripts/check-deployment.mjs https://holler-site.k-porshnieva.workers.dev holler-site
